notes.title: Warp Ball DLC Available!
notes.notes:
Another new off-world destination awaits. Teleport around with the WARP BALL DLC pack for Super Puzzle Galaxy with 24 new levels and 2 new objects. Watch out for the new ice trap that can freeze your ball and slow down your momentum, and keep an eye out for the new rotating obstacle that will turn obstacles.

Use the new Warp Ball ability to solve the 8 puzzling challenge levels and see if you can collect all galaxy gems!


- 2 Bears Studio

notes.title: Editor Features!
notes.notes:
Today we released a new update with a few features we think you will really like. 

1.)	You can now “relaunch” the ball without having to start over from scratch  
2.)	New ability to change the rock terrain in your UGC levels
3.)	Create new Skyboxes in your UGC maps in the editor 


- 2 Bears Studio

notes.title: Boost Ball DLC Available and more!
notes.notes:
A new off-world destination awaits you.  Blast into the BOOST BALL DLC pack for Super Puzzle Galaxy with 24 new levels and 2 new obstacles.

[*] Glass Door - ensure you have enough momentum to breakthrough!

[*] Spring - adjust the angle and use this new spring to bounce your ball to the goal. 

Plus a bunch of updates to our in-game editor, so you can try your hand at making your own level. 

Be sure to grab the new DLC and use the new Boost Ball to overcome 8 devilishly difficult challenge levels.

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
Thank you for all those who have played Super Puzzle Galaxy.  For a limited time, see what it feels like to have it snow in space, well VR space that is.


- 2 Bears Studio

notes.title: Early Access Launch - UGC Feedback
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to bring you Super Puzzle Galaxy.  Our goal was to empower players with a level editor made from the ground up for VR.  

We are not finished by a long shot and we have a lot of features we want to add, but we want to hear from you on the features you want.   

Let us know!

- 2 Bears Studio
